environment.source_runtime: dev whole-image/hash synthetic; separate approved source ONNX supplement

counts.counting_definitions: Surfaces: explicit semantic families in surface-register.csv, not all state variants. Journeys: ordered J records, not source contracts. Branches:509 source contracts. Visual key:UX/state/role/kind/theme/viewport, excludes rejected attempts. Titled overlay count excludes unnamed popovers and tooltip definitions; see source oracle. Native and CSS captures are distinct evidence classes.

hash_scope: SHA-256 over unchanged file bytes; excludes manifest itself, its checksum and Python cache. Evidence commit and archive verification are external receipts to avoid circular identifiers.
privacy: Public synthetic originals and explicitly marked sanitized derivatives only. Private untouched originals stay outside Git. No credentials, snapshots, databases, exports, models or raw logs included.
